nom: CeraVe AM Oil Face Moisturizer Lotion

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin most often describe a mattifying, non-greasy, oil-controlling effect compared with previous products, though one reviewer with oily skin found it left a heavy white cast and didn't absorb well for her.
segments.dry: Reports from dry-skin reviewers vary: some describe strong relief for severely dry, peeling skin, while others warn the lightweight formula may not be moisturizing enough for very dry skin on its own.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers mostly recommend it for oil control, though one found it a bit oily on her skin since the product is formulated more for dry-to-normal skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report no irritation and consider it their go-to product, but several describe rashes, itching, scabbing, redness or breakouts, in a few cases traced to specific sunscreen filters or a reported formula change.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report plumper-looking, less crepey skin and a reduction in the appearance of fine lines with regular use; one reviewer notes it is a basic product and not meant as an anti-aging treatment.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe adequate daily hydration that keeps skin comfortable under sun exposure, but a couple of dry-skin reviewers found the formula too lightweight to be sufficiently moisturizing on its own.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say it calmed existing redness without irritation; against this, two reviewers report their skin became inflamed, red and itchy, one after what she describes as a formula change and one from a reaction to specific sunscreen filters.
concerns.barrier: Only one reviewer describes a specific improvement to her skin barrier, saying her skin looked healthier overall after switching to this product; most other reviewers focus on hydration and sun protection rather than barrier repair specifically.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with hyperpigmentation mainly value the daily SPF as protection against existing spots getting darker rather than as a treatment; one reviewer reports her hyperpigmentation lightened, but credits it to a full routine that also included a vitamin C serum and a retinol product, not this moisturizer alone.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority, including several who say they are acne-prone, report no new breakouts, and some describe existing blemishes calming down; against this, a couple of reviewers, including one with sensitive skin, report new red pimples or a rash after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers with oily or combination skin report a matte, non-greasy finish that controls midday shine better than previous products; one reviewer with oily skin disagrees, describing the product itself as oily-feeling, slow to absorb and leaving a white cast.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a visible white cast, especially on deeper skin tones
Little to no noticeable fragrance for most users
Pump dispenser can stop working before the bottle is empty
Can pill or leave residue when worn under makeup
Small bottle, but one pump covers the whole face
Doubles as moisturizer and SPF, simplifying the routine

extraits.titre: Not For Skin with Sunscreen Sensitivity
extraits.texte: Let me start by saying, this is simply an informative warning to folks that might have skin like mine. I am an avid user of CeraVe products. It is part of my morning and nightly skincare routine. I have sensitive skin prone to dryness and love how their products interact with my skin. EXCEPT this moisturizer. My morning skincare routine consists of the hydrating facial cleanser followed by the eye repair cream, vitamin c serum, and the moisturizing lotion. However, I ran out of the moisturizing lotion and decided to give this a try. Let me preface this next part with the fact that I am notorious for having allergic reactions to sunscreen and skincare products (rashes, swelling, chemical burns, etc.) but I found and use the CeraVe hydrating sunscreen SPF 30 without complication. HOWEVER, I didn’t read the ingredients list for this product (thinking it would match the sunscreen) and there are two ingredients present in this moisturizer that I am finally beginning to understand is a no go for me: Octinoxate & Octocrylene. From what I’ve read, this sort of reaction isn't overly common for sensitive skin, but there’s alarming research none the less. Not to mention, this rash will last 3-4 days while taking Prednisone and using prescription hydrocortisone cream to deal with the itch, heat, and swelling. Again, this is just an informative review. I know and believe this product works for most as I wish it had me, but this goes for all the folks out there prone to topical reactions.

extraits.titre: Sensitive and acne prone skin people beware
extraits.texte: Prior to purchasing the CeraVe Am facial moisturizer with SPF30, I was using a Cetaphil Moisturizer with SPF 50. However, as I was nearing the end of my Cetaphil moisturizer, I began to get more oily and figured I try a different moisturizer. I have also been dealing with Maskne as I’m not allowed to wear a clothe mask at the hospital I’m currently working at, even more reason why I wanted something with acne ridding ingredients. Because of that I figured I’d give the CeraVe AM moisturizer a try especially because of the active ingredients it has (I.e. niacinamide & hyaluronic acid ) as well as the positive reviews it has received on TikTok and here on Amazon. Unfortunately, within the first day my face began to feel itchy, scabby, tingly and I developed a rash all over my face. Prior to this I had been using the Paula’s Choice liquid exfoliate and my skin was smooth except for the areas with maskne. While I understand that everyone’s skin will respond differently, I’m still left with a rash and uncomfortable feeling all over my face. Also, I decided to give a 2 start rating as it began to peel when I tried to massage the moisturizer into my skin. Some positives are that this is more of a sunscreen than a moisturizer, which was what I was looking for. Also, it has no scent which is typically preferred by people with sensitive skin. I will end with the cautionary note to make sure you patch test first!! It’s been 3 days and the rash hasn’t resided.

very oily , doesn’t absorb fast left horrible white cast and wasn’t compatible with a lot of my other skincare products. maybe if you wanna just wear moisturizer with spf and dry skin then this is for u but oily skin did not take. it did help my redness and didn’t irritate or burn which was helpful maybe i will use winter.

extraits.titre: Blown away, a must for oily/combination skin! Wow
extraits.texte: Wowwww!!! For the last year I was using Cetaphil (oil control) moisturizer with spf and it would do a decent job in terms of moisturizing and sun protection it seemed like it only exasperated the oil on my face and come 5pm end of the work day you could see your reflection in my face. I was so blown away by the cereve cleansing water and night cream I figured I needed to ditch the ceraphil day moisturizer with spf and try the am moisturizer with spf. Right away I noticed it’s wayyyyyy less oily and has more of matte finish. It controls oil throughout the day and it’s wonderful. If you have dry skin though you may find it’s a little too lightweight. After using the cleaning water, day cream and night cream I’ve noticed drastic improvements in my skin and with this NC summer heat humidity these are the only products touching my face and I have had zero breakouts or issues. Cereve makes incredible products and is worth every penny seriously! If you have oily or combination skin these products are super lightweight and won’t clog your pores or break you out and if you live in the south you need products like this. Use the entire line though you’ll notice even better results.

Absolutely love this!!!!! Used Cerave because of Hyram from youtube and glad i did.ive been havin the worst dry skin on my face and would be difficult putting on make up because of skin peeling.but after using this everyday my skin is great and moisturized! My make up goes on perfectly now! So happy! Highly recommend!

It’s lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly into the skin. The SPF 30 is perfect for daily protection, and I love that it doesn’t leave a white cast. My skin feels hydrated all day thanks to the hyaluronic acid and ceramides. I’ve noticed a big improvement in my skin barrier, and it looks healthier overall. It works great under makeup too! I will definitely keep repurchasing this product—highly recommended.

I purposely went with this product since I use this entrie product line for my regular skincare routine. Sadly it wasn't a good choice. I wouldn't recommend it for sensitive skin. It made me break out in red little pimples all over my face 😩
